_comment: XListener configuration. Copy to config.json and fill in. Keys prefixed with _ are notes.
_x_user_id_note: REQUIRED. Numeric id of the X account to mirror. The listener does not auto-resolve it from x_user_handle; an empty value fails startup and tools/doctor.py.
_threads_handle_note: Numeric Threads account id goes in .env as THREADS_USER_ID. This is the @handle used only for source URLs and logs.
_state_db_note: SQLite dedupe + audit table. Never commit it. One row per mirrored post.
_media_cache_note: Downloaded X images live here before upload. Never commit it; it is X content.
_media_cache_max_age_note: Cached X images older than this are pruned after each successful mirror. 0 disables pruning.
_python_bin_note: Interpreter used to run threads_poster.py. Empty = the interpreter running the listener.
_publish_timeout_note: Subprocess budget (seconds) for one Threads poster run, including image uploads. A run that exceeds it fails instead of hanging the delivery.

x_budget._note: Hard spend caps for anything that READS X posts, honored by x_budget.get_budget(). X bills per post RETURNED, not per call, so one paginated loop can drain a balance. An env override (X_MAX_POSTS_PER_CALL / X_MAX_CALLS_PER_DAY / X_MAX_POSTS_PER_DAY) wins when set, and every value is clamped to a hard ceiling so nothing can raise a cap past it.

_webhook_crc_key_note: Which secret keys the CRC response_token: auto | oauth2 | legacy. auto = OAuth 2.0 client secret when .env has X_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET, else the OAuth 1.0 consumer secret.

webhook._webhook_note: The listener binds to loopback only; a tunnel exposes it to X. HMAC verification uses secrets from .env.
webhook._observe_note: true = run everything but publish nothing to Threads (dry-run, state.db untouched). Set false for normal operation.
webhook._quote_note: false = skip quote posts (a repost with a comment).
